sentences.en: We are entitled to vote at the age of twenty.
sentences.zh: 我们到二十岁就有投票的权利。

sentences.en: Everyone is entitled to be moody once in a while.
sentences.zh: 每个人偶尔情绪低落是有权利的。

sentences.en: This ticket entitles the bearer to one chocolate ice cream.
sentences.zh: 这张票可以让持票人获得一份巧克力冰淇淋。

senses.zh: 给予（某人）权利，给（某人）资格；给......命名，给......题名

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（使…）+title（题目，标题） →给…题名
